args.reason: The first DoD item (`--dry-run`) serves the inspection goal. The second and third items add a persisted history log at `.faff/merge-gate-history/<pr>.jsonl` and an `--explain` timeline with `--since` and `--format` filters. Those are historical storage and query features, which the first PRD goal explicitly puts outside this PRD. The Phase-1 proposal calls them a natural extension of inspection, but the PRD limits inspection to the current decision. Two of the three DoD capabilities fall outside the declared goals, so the PRDR exceeds its PRD.
